status: Read-only metric feasibility audit; no as-built, occupancy or approval claim.

residentWorkingHypothesis.statement: All top-floor apartments are single rooms, generally similar in size, with dimensional differences described as about a hand length.
residentWorkingHypothesis.meaning: A repeated single-apartment type with small dimensional variation is a qualitative prior. A hand length is not converted into a measured dimensional tolerance.
residentWorkingHypothesis.latestCorrection: The resident confirmed that L1 should match the visible W4 corner overlap and clarified that the extended marked edge divides the stair width into one quarter on the L3 side and three quarters on the R1 side. The latest model retains the estimated L bay widths and derives the staircase from those relationships. Windows, the west stairwell entry and the unresolved R envelopes remain. Absolute dimensions and wall construction are unmeasured.

studyAxes.transform: Orthonormal rotation of existing campus x,z.

sourceMetrics.alignedAxis: Source flat-roof edge 23→0; perpendicular toward edge 20→21.

packing.referenceMeaning: Approximate dimensions from a typical resident sketch, tested numerically as exact values; not a measurement of these twenty rooms.
packing.insetMeaning: Sensitivity clearance, not measured wall thickness or a building-code requirement.
packing.allowedWitnessOrientations: Aligned to either study axis. Negative results with a narrow bounding strip also exclude every rotation.
packing.fullApartmentMeaning: No complete apartment dimensions were supplied; living-zone fit cannot establish a repeated whole-apartment layout.
packing.negativeResultMeaning: A conditional conflict in the current inferred envelopes, not proof that the physical apartments cannot share one type. Approximate reference dimensions and LoD2 uncertainty prevent interpreting a centimetre-scale raw-frontage difference as an interior survey.

shapeSimilarity.scope: Seventeen non-R candidate envelopes; R remains an unresolved width constraint.
shapeSimilarity.meaning: Projected gross polygon extents, not clear interior dimensions or a measured whole-apartment template.

commonDepthVerification.inputMeaning: Retained width-only modeling priors, not measured apartment depths.
commonDepthVerification.laterCorrectionMeaning: The later L alignment follows source corners and retains its fitted south boundary. Its small source-skew depth change is reported explicitly rather than hidden by widening the historical fit tolerance.
commonDepthVerification.method: The arithmetic mean minimizes sum_i (D - priorDepth_i)^2. Unchanged group mean depths are independently checked against D; any later source-alignment correction is identified separately.

windows.meaning: Resident-informed locations; exact centers and widths are estimates. Four shared-area windows do not establish room ownership, doorways or access.

wallFaceHypothesis.requirementMeaning: Necessary width bound under the declared 0.10m-per-side sensitivity; not sufficient to prove a full apartment fit or a measured wall arrangement.
wallFaceHypothesis.westReturnMeaning: Historical comparison against the preceding 0.20m wall-band hypothesis, using a plan-axis average. The current stairAlignment section measures the actual corner-normal overlap and whether L1 matches it; no verified wall assembly is inferred.
wallFaceHypothesis.wallBandMeaning: Display hypothesis within gross envelopes, not extra usable floor area; independent spaces remain disjoint.

reference.meaning: The resident-marked exterior return is extended as a line; its geometry is not moved.

stairAlignment.orientationClarification: The resident explicitly clarified that three quarters lies on the R1 side. Side names override ambiguous screen-left/right wording.

overlap.meaning: Equal projected offsets of room dividers past source returns. This confirms relative alignment, not measured masonry thickness or overlapping room interiors.

stairAlignment.meaning: Ratios are recomputed from actual enclosure cross-sections normal to the unchanged source edge. Gross width is derived after retaining the estimated L bays; it is not a surveyed or clear stair dimension.

topology.accessMeaning: Edges use saved door segments only. Separate hallways do not imply a verified route through the stairwell; no eastern stairwell door is inferred.

flight.meaning: Separate schematic flight footprint; tread geometry, rise and exact landing dimensions are unmeasured.

topology.probeMeaning: Room boundary-midpoint approaches and the declared stairwell-door approach, offset 0.66m into their respective hallway. These do not establish inter-hallway connectivity, passage through a door, or egress/accessibility compliance.
